sections.heading: 1. Back-friendly stand
lines: ① Scoot your bottom to the front edge.
② Feet hip-width, tucked under your knees.
③ Lean so your nose is over your toes.
④ Push through your thighs, stand slowly.

caption:
After work, Mr Turtle sinks into a deep, soft sofa. Getting back up is where the back starts to grumble.

The lower the seat, the harder your legs and back have to work to stand. Scoot to the front edge, tuck your feet under your knees, lean until your nose is over your toes, then push through your thighs and stand slowly. A firm cushion to lift the seat a little can also help.

Pain spreading down a leg, soreness even at rest, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
